displayName: OCI-LAT-CHN-004: Lateral movement chain — WinRM → PS Remoting → Domain Controller
description:
Detects WinRM-based lateral movement using PowerShell remoting to reach domain controllers

⚠️ NEEDS-REWRITE: Query is generic SQL, needs conversion to Cloud Guard detector condition

conditions.value: lateral movement chain — winrm → ps remoting → dom

dataSourceDetails.query: SELECT "siem_general_lat_chn_004", "action" FROM "oci_monitoring_metricexplorer_metrics" WHERE "compartmentId" = '$COMPARTMENT_ID' AND "namespace" = 'VcnFlowLogs' AND "action" = 'REJECT' AND "srcaddr" NOT LIKE '10.%' AND "dstaddr" NOT LIKE '10.%' AND "value" > 0
